sources.title: Legacy linked festive PDF with corrupt/missing font resources
sources.notes: HTTP 200 serves exactly 1048576 bytes; ordinary Range 0-0 check confirms total file length 1048576. PDF lacks a clean end and requires repair; MuPDF reports missing XObjects, extracted text is cipher-like and the rendered page has unreadable glyphs. No food names or prices inferred from the corrupt file. No current menu applicability.
